2: To the Overseer, for Jeduthun. --A Psalm of David. Only--toward God is my soul silent, From Him is my salvation.
3: Only--He is my rock, and my salvation, My tower, I am not much moved.
4: Till when do ye devise mischief against a man? Ye are destroyed all of you, As a wall inclined, a hedge that is cast down.
5: Only--from his excellency They have consulted to drive away, They enjoy a lie, with their mouth they bless, And with their heart revile. Selah.
6: Only--for God, be silent, O my soul, For from Him is my hope.
7: Only--He is my rock and my salvation, My tower, I am not moved.
8: On God is my salvation, and my honour, The rock of my strength, my refuge is in God.
9: Trust in Him at all times, O people, Pour forth before Him your heart, God is a refuge for us. Selah.
10: Only--vanity are the low, a lie the high. In balances to go up they than vanity are lighter.
11: Trust not in oppression, And in robbery become not vain, Wealth--when it increaseth--set not the heart.
12: Once hath God spoken, twice I heard this, That `strength is with God.'
13: And with Thee, O Lord, is kindness, For Thou dost recompense to each, According to his work!
